adaptations.withheld: sacred or restricted dance: no teaching adaptations

movement_profile.formation_and_space: Circle formation with close physical contact between men and unmarried women
movement_profile.partnering: Men and unmarried women dance together; married women do not dance
movement_profile.what_to_avoid: Avoid inappropriate physical contact and participation by married women or outsiders during sacred rituals.

music_profile.sound_description: The music features vocal chanting and singing in the Uma raego language, including trance-like elements intended for healing and ritual communication.
music_profile.vocal_style: Singing in Uma raego language with trance-like chanting for healing

basic_steps: Men and unmarried women dance in close contact
Sing in Uma raego language while dancing
Include trance-like chanting for healing segments
teaching.level_notes: Beginners should start by learning the circle formation and basic singing; physical contact and trance elements require cultural sensitivity.
